trigger: Sector 4 quarantine sweep. Ruiz's squad reaches your block.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: [Loudspeaker] Sector 4 is under quarantine. Remain indoors. Declare weapons and stores over fourteen days.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Typhoid is real here. Six dead this week. So are the trucks loading confiscated food.

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Ms. Dell. Grandpa's got three months of soup cans. They'll take it. Can we hide it at yours?

choices.text: Declare it. It's not worth getting shot.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Marguerite hands you a cigar box over the fence: the clinic's morphine. 'Under your floor. Please.'

choices.text: I can't risk Theo for this.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It goes on a truck. Somewhere, a quartermaster counts it.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Floorboards up, cans in, rug down. Your hands are shaking. Boots on the porch.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Kowalczyk. Small world. Weapons, stores, sympathizers. Any of the three.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: You're not even in the registry. Unregistered household, Sector 4. That's a full search.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: You shorted my cabinet. Lieutenant wants you processed. I'm the one who decides if you're home.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She looks at the rug. At the scuffed boards. At Theo in the doorway.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: On the way out she taps the list on her clipboard. Kids' houses have a pencil mark. Skipped.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Clear. Stay inside. Boil your water. I mean it.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: At the checkpoint, a list goes up on plywood: INFORMANT-VERIFIED HOUSEHOLDS. With sources.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ray stands in front of it a long time. BREKKE, R. SOURCE: KOWALCZYK, A.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He doesn't come to your door. He doesn't have to.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: By evening, Theo is gone. His note: 'don't be mad. i can help. — T'
